entries.script:
## slide 1 · hook
Doors open this Black Friday.
The Clear Code Protocol, phase two.

## slide 2 · the problem
Acne clients keep finding you.
But you build the programme as you go. A new plan for every client, and no system behind any of it.

## slide 3 · the cost
And it's exhausting.
Months of guesswork and second-guessing, when you could be treating.

## slide 4 · the answer
So I built the framework.
The Clear Code Protocol is a done-for-you framework to build an acne programme in your clinic.

## slide 5 · what's inside
What you actually get.
A complete guide for you to successfully plan, launch and nurture your Acne programme. With even more ready to use resources, client education and a purpose built Acne consultation form, this collaborative style approach will ensure you get results.

## slide 6 · phase two
Phase two is here.
25+ specialists joined at launch. Their feedback shaped every upgrade.

## slide 7 · doors
Doors open Friday 27 November.
They won't be open for very long. Tap the link in our bio to join the waitlist.
